targets.review_note: Grow every initially nonempty color before exporting: it has A_i+C_i balls and at most min(B_i,A_i+C_i) convertible balls. Their total is the initial seed budget. An empty color with B_i>0 can be seeded using one conversion, use all C_i growth tools, and return min(B_i,C_i+1) further convertible balls, a nonnegative net gain. Thus any positive initial seed budget can activate all such colors in a chain. To maximize total balls, use the resulting seed budget on empty colors with B_i=0 in descending C_i order. To maximize one target color, export all other usable balls to it and retain its own growth; subtract its contribution to export/net-gain bookkeeping to avoid double counting. If seed budget is zero, only initially nonempty colors can grow. All counts use unbounded integers.
